war_summary: War 139 is on day 122 with no winner. Colonials hold a dominant strategic position with approximately 195 bases to Wardens' 65 across 40 regions. The most intense combat zones are Clahstra, Endless Shore, Callahans Passage, Marban Hollow, Onyx, and Speaking Woods, where both factions are sustaining heavy casualties with accelerating trends and active base flipping. Clahstra shows the highest recent intensity (2,600+ casualties/hr per side) with 16 events/24h across 4 active bases and a latest event at 18:11 UTC. Endless Shore follows with 1,900+ casualties/hr per side and 43 events/24h across 5 active bases, latest event at 18:11 UTC. Callahans Passage has 1,400+ casualties/hr per side with 8 events/24h across 3 active bases, latest event at 16:16 UTC. Marban Hollow has surged to 1,700+ casualties/hr per side with accelerating trends and 7 events/24h, latest event at 06:56 UTC. Onyx shows 2,600+ casualties/hr per side with accelerating trends and 5 events/24h, latest event at 12:21 UTC. Speaking Woods has 2,100+ casualties/hr per side with 6 events/24h, latest event at 18:11 UTC. Wardens hold quiet northern regions (Basin Sionnach, Clanshead, Howl County, Viper Pit, Weathered Expanse, Reaching Trail) but face heavy pressure in Speaking Woods. Large Colonial rear areas (Deadlands, Drowned Vale, Allods Bight, etc.) are quiet with minimal casualties.
